FIELDS.NAME: Cellular Connect Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Cellular Connect Solutions, we specialize in the retail sale and repair of cellular phones and accessories. Our core operations include providing a wide range of the latest cellular devices from authorized manufacturers, alongside offering quality repair services such as screen replacements, battery swaps, and software updates. We prioritize customer satisfaction with clear, written repair and warranty policies, ensuring transparency and trust. Our inventory management system helps us maintain product quality and manage stock effectively, reducing the risk of errors and employee theft. Additionally, our trained staff undergo regular background checks to ensure a safe and secure shopping environment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, we experienced water damage in our storage area due to a burst pipe, resulting in a loss of $3,000. The damage has been repaired, and all affected inventory was accounted for and replaced. On June 15, 2023, we had a minor incident involving a customer slip and fall, which resulted in a claim of $2,500. This claim has been settled amicably, and safety measures have been reinforced. Total losses: $5,500.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Sunday 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard safe for electronic devices, UL listed, Class B, secured with biometric access and alarm system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and security personnel on-site during business hours.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost value with warranty coverage
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose of, or transport hazardous materials as part of its retail and repair operations for cellular phones and accessories. Our focus is solely on retail and non-hazardous repair services.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its operations. Our focus is primarily on retail sales and repair services for cellular devices.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our management team to ensure compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crimes for any applicant in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Cellular Connect Solutions has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the prior three years. All insurance coverage has been maintained without interruption.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our workforce is comprised entirely of employed staff directly by the company.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not currently carry Workers' Compensation insurance as we have a small team of employees and are exempt from this requirement under state regulations. We ensure a safe working environment and comply with all necessary safety laws.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not own or operate any other business; we are solely focused on our retail and repair operations for cellular phones and accessories.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. Our current coverage is sufficient for our retail and repair operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Cellular Connect Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retail sales and repair services for cellular phones and accessories.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus exclusively on retail sales and repairs of cellular phones and accessories.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Cellular Connect Solutions has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien within the past five years. We maintain a sound financial standing and have no outstanding financial issues.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on the retail sale and repair of non-hazardous cellular phones and accessories.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Cellular Connect Solutions does not have any exposure to catastrophe risks as our operations focus solely on retail sales and repair services for cellular phones and accessories. Our business practices and location minimize potential vulnerabilities to catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Cellular Connect Solutions has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize compliance and create a safe environment for both employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Cellular Connect Solutions has no uncorrected fire code violations. All safety inspections are up to date, and we comply with fire safety regulations.
